content:
Alex: Hey — hitting 401 invalid_api_key on embeddings calls coming from our edge cache (Fastly). Same API key works from my laptop.
Alex: Repro: `curl -vS -H 'Authorization: Apikey sk-prod_ABC123' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings` -> response body: {"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"API key invalid or expired"}.
Support-Bot: Incident created: INC-3721 (auto).
Jordan: Can you paste the exact curl (with the key redacted) and the full response body? Also confirm whether this key was copied from the Dashboard copy-button or provisioned via API/CLI.
Alex: Copied from Dashboard. No expiry showing in UI. I put it into Fastly secret store. From inside the worker I see the same 401.
Maria: A few possibilities: CDNs/edge workers sometimes strip or rewrite Authorization, secrets can get trailing newlines or be base64-encoded accidentally, or the key might be for a different org/environment (hosted vs dedicated).
Alex: Worker code snippet: `await fetch(apiEndpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: `Apikey ${KEY}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) })` — note I'm using lowercase `authorization` header.
Jordan: Header casing shouldn't matter, but some edge configs drop Authorization to origin unless you explicitly forward it. Quick test: can you try using `x-api-key` header from the worker as a probe? `curl -H 'x-api-key: sk-prod_ABC123' ...`
Alex: Tried `x-api-key` -> same 401. I also inspected Fastly logs and the header arriving at our gateway looks truncated: `Apikey sk-prod_ABC...` (ends earlier than expected).
Maria: That suggests the secret may have been truncated on upload or contains an extra byte that causes parsing issues. Two checks: 1) verify the raw bytes of the stored secret (no trailing newline), 2) confirm the key prefix/ID matches the Dashboard (not a key id only).
Alex: Ran a quick local check: `echo "$KEY" | od -An -t x1` and saw `0a` at the end (newline). I also compared last 8 chars with the Dashboard privately to support and they matched except the newline.
Jordan: Trailing newline will cause our auth parser to reject the key. Fastly secret providers sometimes append newlines if you paste with `Enter`. Fix: re-upload the secret without newline, e.g. `printf '%s' "$KEY" | fastly secret create ...` or trim programmatically before sending.
Alex: Re-uploaded the secret without newline and retried — requests succeed now. Thanks :tada:
Maria: We'll add a short KB note for edge teams: "Trim secrets when uploading to CDN secret stores" and include diagnostic steps (xxd/od and checking last 8 chars). I'll file SH-Auth-Edge-Trim.
Jordan: Great root cause. I'll close INC-3721 after you confirm no other edge regions are impacted.
Alex: Doing a sweep now across our other Fastly services, will report if anything else pops up. Thanks all!
